chamber.note: Concept chamber. Rounded-corner enclosure, structural portals and instrument hardware are visual; solver remains freestream and excludes walls/support interference.

assumptions: Spanwise integration of the exported main-wing/control-surface outer chord envelope (includes merged root fillets), plus a 1 m fuselage-covered strip at the measured root chord. 800 midpoint slices per half-wing; internal chordwise hinge gaps filled; spanwise control gaps remain.

Leading-edge height as lifting-surface datum; zero twist/incidence assumed. Symmetric reconstruction.
